dct_description_sm: This dataset is used to quantify the detailed physical characteristics of Thores Glacier and its interaction with adjacent Thores Lake, including glacier extent, surface features, and surface elevation during a July 2019 field campaign. These measurements were limited to the lower part of the glacier (mainly ablation area) due to access limitations and snow cover higher up limiting the effectiveness of the photogrammetry survey. We took a series of pictures of Thores Glacier, Ellesmere Island, Canada in July, 2019 to build a three-dimensional model of the glacier. These photos show what the glacier looked like at that time including streams on the glacier surface.
dct_title_s: Photogrammetry Digital Elevation Model and Orthomosaic of Thores Glacier, Ellesmere Island, Canada
